نبذة

Indigo Salon is a new luxury beauty salon located in Al Muroor Street, Abu Dhabi. We offer a wide range of services such as manicure & pedicure, hair cutting, different hair styling and treatments, eyelash extensions, waxing, threading, massages and many more. Our professional and well-experienced staff will be able to meet all your beauty needs.

Indigo Ladies Salon is especially praised for its polished hair results, with clients appreciating the stylists’ careful attention and ability to deliver the look requested. Blow dries and haircuts sit alongside classic spa manicures and pedicures, all supported by friendly, professional service and a clean, calming setting that helps clients leave feeling relaxed and pleased with their results.
